name: North Carolina

agency.name: North Carolina State Education Assistance Authority (NCSEAA)

programs.name: Next NC Scholarship
programs.summary: For families with an adjusted gross income of $80,000 or less and a Student Aid Index of 7,500 or less: at least $5,000 a year at a UNC System university or $3,000 at a community college, from the FAFSA (the Pell Grant counts toward it).

award.summary: At least $5,000 a year at UNC System universities and $3,000 at NC community colleges (federal and state grants combined).

programs.name: NC Promise tuition
programs.summary: $500 a semester tuition for North Carolina residents at Elizabeth City State, Fayetteville State, UNC Pembroke and Western Carolina. No application.

award.summary: Tuition of $500 a semester for in-state students (fees, housing and meals are extra).

programs.name: NC Need-Based Scholarship (private colleges)
programs.summary: Need-based award for North Carolina residents at eligible private nonprofit North Carolina colleges, from the FAFSA.

award.summary: Set each year by the state.

aid_steps.title: Complete North Carolina's Residency Determination (RDS)
aid_steps.summary: North Carolina colleges use the Residency Determination Service to decide in-state tuition and state grants. Skip it and the student is treated as out-of-state.
how: Open the Residency Determination Service site and sign in with the student's account.
Answer the questions about where the family has lived for the past 12 months. A parent may need to help.
Save the Residency Certificate Number and give it to each North Carolina college that asks.
watch_out: Never type passwords or Social Security numbers into ScholarTasks.

counselor_notes: North Carolina has no statewide merit scholarship like HOPE. State money is need-based: the Next NC Scholarship (AGI $80,000 or less) comes from the FAFSA. Every student must complete the Residency Determination Service (RDS) to get in-state tuition and state grants.

NC Promise sets tuition at $500 a semester for residents at Elizabeth City State, Fayetteville State, UNC Pembroke and Western Carolina. Career and College Promise gives free community college classes to eligible high school juniors and seniors, and the Comprehensive Articulation Agreement lets an associate degree transfer to UNC System universities. CFNC (cfnc.org) is the state's planning and application site.
